message: type = 'CR2' is not defined for a marginal-likelihood fit. The Bell-McCaffrey family is built from the hat matrix of a linear (or GLS) model, which a Laplace-marginal likelihood with a nonlinear link does not have, and frmtmb will not ship an adjustment with no derivation behind it. Use type = 'CR1'
